thread:
Lukas (Client CTO):
Hey team, for the POC we need a copy of request-level audit logs (who called the API, timestamps, model used, and response status). Our compliance folks need to validate retention and tamper-resistance. Is this something you can provide for a 2-week eval? Also need an access plan for a single read-only engineer and SSO.

Alex (AE):
Yep — we can do that. Quick clarifying q: do you want streaming to your SIEM or periodic exports? Also can we provide time-limited hosted API keys scoped read-only for telemetry? :white_check_mark:

Priya (SE):
We usually offer two options: (1) continuous syslog/HTTPS push to a customer endpoint (webhook/SIEM) or (2) daily signed export to a customer S3 bucket. For POCs we often do daily signed exports + a short-term, scoped API key for reproducing requests.

Marta (InfoSec):
Couple of constraints from our end: exported logs will include metadata but we redact request bodies by default for hosted tenants unless customer opts-in. For dedicated/private we can enable full payload logging under an NDA. For the POC, if full request/response is needed, ask the customer to sign the additional data access addendum (DAA).

Lukas (Client CTO):
We need API-level metadata (no PII) so daily signed export to our S3 is fine. How do you sign the export and where can we verify integrity? Also need the hosted API key limited to a single IP and expiry in 72 hours.

Alex (AE):
Plan: 1) Priya will create a scoped API key with IP restriction + 72h TTL. 2) Provision-bot will enable daily signed exports to the bucket you provide (we use AWS KMS to sign the manifest). 3) Marta will confirm redaction policy and provide the DAA link if needed.

provision-bot:
Automation note: creating short-lived key now. Command logged.

Priya (SE):
Lukas — please share the S3 bucket ARN (write access for a single prefix) and the principal we should use for the put. Example we need: arn:aws:s3:::acme-poc-logs and prefix "redwood-exports/\". Also share the IP block to pin the API key to.

Lukas (Client CTO):
Bucket: arn:aws:s3:::acme-poc-logs, prefix redwood-exports/, principal: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/RedwoodPutRole, IP: 203.0.113.45/32. We'll confirm encryption settings (SSE-KMS) shortly.

Priya (SE):
Thanks. Creating the export config now. Sample policy we will apply to the key (read-only telemetry):

```
{ "scope": ["audit:read","models:usage:read"],
  "resources": ["org:acme","project:poc"],
  "expiry": "72h",
  "ip_restrict": "203.0.113.45/32"
}
```

I will DM you the API key once provisioned.

Marta (InfoSec):
One more ask: provide a signed digest for each daily export (SHA256) plus the KMS key ID used. We need this as evidence for tamper-resistance checks. Also preserve export logs for 90 days for the SOC2 reviewers.

Alex (AE):
We can add a manifest file alongside each export: redwood-exports/YYYY-MM-DD/manifest.json with sha256 and signed_by_kms_key. We keep a copy for 90 days and provide a signed proof bundle on request.

Lukas (Client CTO):
Perfect. Can you also confirm the retention and deletion workflow for the scoped API key after the 72h window — we want an audit trail showing creation and deletion timestamps.

provision-bot:
Key created: key_id rk-3f7a9c, created_at 1843507905. TTL: 72h. IP restriction: 203.0.113.45/32. Scope applied.

Priya (SE):
Key will auto-expire and be rotated/archived; deletion event is logged to the platform audit stream and included in the daily export manifest. I'll attach the curl example you can use during the POC:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer rk-3f7a9c" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.1","input":"Hello"}'
```

Please avoid sending PII in the request body; our hosted logs redact it by default.

Marta (InfoSec):
We'll review the manifest format, but this meets the tamper-resistance ask. Send over the DAA link if full payloads are requested later.

Alex (AE):
Action items: Priya - finish export + key DM (today EOD). Marta - share DAA link if needed. Lukas - confirm SSE-KMS key ID for bucket. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to walk the security team through the artifacts. :calendar:

Lukas (Client CTO):
All good — will confirm SSE-KMS and we appreciate the 90-day export retention. See you on the sync.

Priya (SE):
DM sent with pre-provision checklist and the key metadata. If anyone needs the sample manifest schema I posted it in #eng-security earlier, ping me and I'll copy it here. :thumbsup:

Alex (AE):
Thanks everyone, closing the request here but keeping the thread for the sync notes. :rocket:
